authority: Design audit only; implementation follows independently accepted DESIGN_REVIEW; zero main or runtime mutations

rca_layers.L0_constitutional: Ingress accepts unauthenticated messages from arbitrary users into Zenoh cog bus; missing 2oo3 quorum on mutating actions; /tool currently passes None/False and halts closed
rca_layers.L1_atomic_data: tools/telegram_client.ml line 567 prints unredacted private message text to stdout; line 570 emits immediate optimistic reactions before downstream acceptance
rca_layers.L2_component_lifecycle: tools/telegram_client.ml lines 545-546 marks update processed and advances poll offset before verified downstream acceptance by Gleam/Zenoh, creating silent message loss on failure
rca_layers.L3_transaction_fencing: cognitive_worker /tool maps to dispatch_action_request with lease_opt: None and authority_verified: False, correctly rejecting caller-invented leases but lacking canonical direct read dispatch delegation
rca_layers.L4_system_bus: cognitive_worker line 2699 deletes shared Zenoh key indrajaal/l5/cog/intent/req via http_delete, racing concurrent intents and causing batch drop
rca_layers.L5_cognitive_routing: Informational commands (/start, /status, /doctor, /plan) work well, but /tool lacks bounded read dispatch integration with direct_read_dispatch
rca_layers.L6_ecosystem_api: BotAPI polling lacks chat/user allowlist enforcement at ingress; token and default chat loaded from DB/env without identity verification
rca_layers.L7_federation_symbiosis: Gleam must own authentication, dispatch, task binding, and delivery policy per SC-HARNESS-MCP-001; native IO acts as subordinate bounded transport
rca_layers.L8_delivery_ledger: No durable SQLite delivery ledger; outcomes are unacknowledged or subject to blind retries without idempotency keys
rca_layers.L9_meta_provenance: Reliance on synthetic test fixtures instead of verified canonical direct_read_dispatch and real BotAPI contract

trust_boundaries.untrusted_ingress: Internet Telegram BotAPI -> Ingress Adapter; strictly filtered by allowlist (allowed_chat_ids, allowed_user_ids) before parsing or publishing
trust_boundaries.cooperative_local_launcher: NAS-1 same-Unix-user (an) trusted service environment holding canonical task resource and coordinator lease for bounded operations
trust_boundaries.execution_authority: Operator chat identity is an authenticated user identity, not a Sa-plan lease. Bounded reads execute under service direct_read_dispatch; mutating tools require 2oo3 quorum and canonical task lease
trust_boundaries.delivery_ledger: Local SQLite ledger guarantees at-least-once durable intake before offset commit, and at-most-once delivery tracking with UNCERTAIN failure semantics

exact_ingress_integration.allowlist_gate: Before parsing message text or reacting, query SQLite preferences/table for allowed chat_ids and usernames. Drop un-allowlisted senders immediately with zero bus publication and zero reaction
exact_ingress_integration.durable_intake_gate: Replace lines 545-546: INSERT update into telegram_inbox table in SQLite WAL with status PENDING. Commit transaction before advancing telegram_poll_offset. If insert fails, do not advance offset
exact_ingress_integration.logging_redaction: Replace line 567 printf with egress_redactor sanitized logging (truncate/hash text, omit private tokens)
exact_ingress_integration.reaction_policy: Remove line 570 immediate optimistic reaction; reactions only permitted after downstream Gleam confirmation

durable_database_io_adapter.store: var/telegram/state.sqlite3 (WAL mode, PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL, busy_timeout = 5000)
durable_database_io_adapter.inbox_table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_inbox (update_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, message_id INTEGER, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, from_user TEXT NOT NULL, text_hash TEXT NOT NULL, raw_payload TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'REJECTED')), created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at_ms INTEGER);
durable_database_io_adapter.outbox_ledger_table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_outbox_ledger (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL, text_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'UNCERTAIN')), telegram_msg_id INTEGER, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error_detail TEXT, created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL);
durable_database_io_adapter.invariant: Offset commit strictly follows successful SQLite inbox transaction commit

canonical_task_lifecycle.request_identification: Inbound Telegram update assigned deterministic request_id: req-tg-<update_id>-<text_hash_prefix>
canonical_task_lifecycle.direct_read_authority: For query_doctor and query_saplan, Gleam cognitive worker executes via direct_read_dispatch using server-side local launcher binding (UOS_DIRECT_ROLE=direct_read) and active task resource. No caller-supplied lease is trusted
canonical_task_lifecycle.mutating_action_authority: Direct /tool mutating commands refuse execution (-32002). Operator must initiate two-step /approval <plan_id> <task_id> <title> workflow acquiring 2oo3 constitutional quorum and canonical Sa-plan lease before execution

security_and_operational_invariants.forged_zenoh_payload_refusal: Cognitive worker validates sender chat_id and from_user against internal compiled allowlist, rejecting forged payloads even if injected on Zenoh bus. Tool dispatcher never sets authority_verified=True from payload fields
security_and_operational_invariants.server_side_direct_read_authority: direct_read_dispatch loads trusted environment binding from local launcher (never request JSON). Validates 6 UOS_DIRECT_* fields, performs pre/post fences with clock continuity, and executes read tools
security_and_operational_invariants.delivery_unknown_reconciliation: Outbound BotAPI timeouts or HTTP 5xx errors record status UNCERTAIN in telegram_outbox_ledger. Blind retries are strictly prohibited to prevent duplicate messages or double executions. Explicit retries must carry the same request_id and incremented attempt_count
security_and_operational_invariants.single_writer_restart: Exclusive SQLite writer transaction (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) prevents multi-writer races. Service acquires coordinator lease service:telegram_bridge. On restart, recovery query identifies uncompleted PENDING/PROCESSING updates and resumes getUpdates strictly from max(update_id)+1

smallest_usable_production_design.component_1_ingress_guard: tools/telegram_client.ml allowlist verification and payload redaction
smallest_usable_production_design.component_2_durable_ledger: SQLite WAL telegram_inbox and telegram_outbox_ledger tables
smallest_usable_production_design.component_3_non_destructive_bus: Per-update Zenoh subkeys or direct SQLite inbox queue; eliminate http_delete on shared intent key
smallest_usable_production_design.component_4_bounded_tool_dispatch: Route /tool query_doctor and query_saplan through direct_read_dispatch; refuse mutating tools

acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Non-allowlisted chat/user rejected at ingress with zero bus publication and zero offset corruption
AC-02: Private payload text redacted from all operational logs and traces
AC-03: Telegram update offset advances only upon verified durable ledger storage
AC-04: /tool query_doctor and /tool query_saplan return authentic un-fabricated system status via direct_read_dispatch
AC-05: /tool <mutating_tool> fails closed with 2oo3 quorum and Sa-plan lease requirement
AC-06: Shared Zenoh request keys are never destructively wiped
AC-07: Outbound delivery failure is durably recorded as UNCERTAIN or FAILED, never false ACK
AC-08: Standard bot directives (/start, /help, /doctor, /status) preserve 100% existing functionality
falsifiers: F-01: Unauthorized sender update published to indrajaal/l5/cog/intent/req
F-02: /tool query_doctor with arguments executes or accepts arguments
F-03: /tool mutating action executes without 2oo3 quorum
F-04: Downstream failure loses un-persisted Telegram update while offset advanced
F-05: http_delete wipes unread messages on shared request key
